subject: ddl: fix unexpected nil pointer dereference (#64244)
summary: Commit only changes `pkg/ddl/job_scheduler.go` to guard `workerPoolExhausted()` against `bgJobWorkerPool == nil`. This matches the scheduler lifecycle: `bgJobWorkerPool` is only initialized under `kerneltype.IsNextGen()` (compile-time build tag), while classic builds leave it nil; without the guard, classic builds could panic when `loadAndDeliverJobs()` calls `workerPoolExhausted()`. No other unguarded uses of `bgJobWorkerPool` exist outside `IsNextGen()`-gated paths, and later `upstream/master` history touching this file does not modify this logic.
